objective: High two-lap completion with minimum total lap time; racing line, speed and steering are jointly improvable.
previous_limitations: Minimum-curvature initialization and broad local offset bumps restrict useful shape exploration.
A 1m smoothed-curvature speed profile can hide short sharp features.
Independent acceleration/braking and lateral bounds omit the combined force tradeoff.
Preview and teacher independently recompute speed; exporting path alone discards optimized speeds.
Reference deviation, imitation and retention guidance can together constrain PPO exploration.

implemented_now.method: Periodic C4 quintic path knots and collocated squared speeds jointly optimized by scaled SLSQP with forward-mode automatic Jacobians; analytic steering-rate and both-endpoint longitudinal constraints.
implemented_now.objective: sum of segment travel times; no minimum-curvature or shortest-distance surrogate in objective
constraints: analytic spline curvature with +/-0.50rad kinematic steering
provisional combined accel ellipse using lateral6.0, acceleration2.9, braking3.7; vmax8.0
implemented_now.control: Optimize speed on matched reconstructed stored geometry with the same constraints; compare joint-from-stored and joint-from-center.
implemented_now.solver_stabilization: C2 finite-difference rate candidate from both initializations converged but failed dense rate/force/body constraints. Rejected. C4 analytic-rate version under test.

model_limitations: Quasi-steady bicycle geometry, not full slip dynamics or delayed actuator OCP.
Current grip ellipse is an explicit hypothesis; not a measured hardware envelope.
Spline knot corridor and sampled body clearance do not certify continuous swept-body feasibility.
Direct collocation samples must pass a denser independent audit.
Local nonlinear optimizer has no global optimality certificate.

traffic_requirement.user_clarification: Two cars share one course and start simultaneously from different/opposite positions on the lap; not an assumed head-on road encounter.
traffic_requirement.start_gap: Variable separated arc-length starts; approximately half a lap as a scenario, not a measured rule.
traffic_requirement.direction: Do not infer oncoming traffic from opposite starting positions. Model common race-direction starts as the primary working scenario, retain direction as an explicit parameter.
